name: Evrima
lede: The first ship of The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection was built as a hotel at sea, with a superyacht’s design. Platinum Electric Marine heaters, recessed into the ceilings of six open deck areas, keep its 298 passengers comfortable outside all year.
data: Six open deck areas – restaurants and lounges
Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric Marine · Platinum Electric Recess Kit

hero.caption: The pool bar, heaters recessed in the curved ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

The pool deck under the overhang. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: Evrima has 149 suite-style cabins, six restaurants, four pools, two bars, a spa deck and a water-level marina terrace, all designed to blend with their surroundings.
The open decks needed heating that matched the luxury design – concealed and recessed in the ceiling – and made the outdoor spaces usable all year.

Bromic’s Daniel Bruntsch provided a 2D heat plan through the complimentary design service. The layout followed the restaurant seating and the lounge sofas, and the heaters were recessed with the Platinum Electric Recess Kit across six open deck areas.

quote.text: The passenger comfort level on a luxury cruise ship or yacht should be the main goal of the experience.
